questions.stem:
Syllogism: All birds fly. Some flying things sing. No singer is silent.

I. Some birds sing. II. Some birds are not silent.
questions.explanation: I: Birds ⊂ flying; some flying sing — no overlap guaranteed. NOT TRUE. II: Some flying sing → no singer is silent → those particular flying things aren't silent, but they may not all be birds. NOT NECESSARILY TRUE.

questions.passage_context: India's renewable-energy expansion is among the most ambitious in the world. By 2030, the country targets 500 GW of non-fossil capacity. Solar prices have fallen by over 80% in a decade. Wind farms operate across coastal states. Yet the next phase faces structural challenges: land acquisition, transmission infrastructure, and end-of-life recycling of solar panels and wind turbines. Battery storage is emerging as the most critical constraint, since renewable generation is intermittent. Without affordable storage, even ambitious capacity targets may not translate into reliable, round-the-clock clean power.
questions.subject: ENGLISH
